page_title: VER 1-2 INT | Verona v Inter 02/11/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+6' Is that a yellow card in the referee's hand? It is! Armel Bella-Kotchap (Verona) gets booked.
90+3' Francesco Pio Esposito (Inter) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
90+3' Referee Daniele Doveri halts the game and wanders over to the touchline to talk to Paolo Zanetti, then shows him a yellow.

90+2' 1 - 2 Martin Frese (Verona) attempts to head the ball away after a cross into the penalty area, but instead he accidentally sends it inside the left post of his own goal. The goalkeeper was helpless.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

90' Davide Frattesi (Inter) reacts well and displays good awareness inside the box to get on the end of the resulting corner kick. He fails to direct the ball into the net as it flies narrowly wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Verona.
90' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
90' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player. The referee points to the corner flag and Inter will take a corner.
89' Corner kick. Verona will have an opportunity.
89' Federico Dimarco (Inter) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the ref turns down the penalty appeals and waves play on!
88' Paolo Zanetti has decided to substitute Jean-Daniel Akpa Akpro and he is replaced by Abdou Harroui (Verona).
88' We are about to witness a substitution. Davide Frattesi (Inter) is replacing Petar Sucic.
87' Nicolo Barella (Inter) squanders a big chance! The ball rebounded out to him and he misdirects his shot well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Verona.
87' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
87' Neat passing move from Inter in order to create new attacking opportunities.

85' Francesco Pio Esposito (Inter) climbs high to meet a cross on the edge of the box, but it's a poor header and goes well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Verona will have a goal kick.
84' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
83' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) brings down the pass, looks up and shoots from distance, but it's straight at a defender who unwittingly blocks it.
81' Federico Dimarco (Inter) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The ball is behind the touchline and Inter will take a throw-in.
80' Substitution. Giovane makes his way off the pitch and Amin Sarr (Verona) comes on as his replacement.
79' The fouls committed statistics – 13:4.
77' Federico Dimarco (Inter) extricates himself from the difficult situation with a good pass, comfortably eluding the pressing opponent.

74' Daniele Doveri blows his whistle as Denzel Dumfries (Inter) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack. Verona win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
73' Paolo Zanetti prepares a substitution. Gift Orban is replaced by Daniel Mosquera (Verona).
73' It's time for a substitution. Cheikh Niasse (Verona) comes on in place of Antoine Bernede.

73' That was close! Francesco Pio Esposito (Inter) makes a good run into the centre of the box and gets his head onto a lofted pass, but sends the ball a fraction over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Verona.
72' Inter control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
69' The foul by Francesco Pio Esposito (Inter) was seen by Daniele Doveri who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle. Verona are awarded the free kick.
66' Yann Bisseck (Inter) takes out his opponent with a horrible challenge and is relieved when the referee only shows him a yellow card.
65' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Carlos Augusto leaves the pitch and Federico Dimarco (Inter) comes on.
63' Gift Orban (Verona) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
61' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) takes the corner.
61' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Alessandro Bastoni (Inter). Inter force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
59' The possession of the ball – 32:68.
55' Substitution. Francesco Pio Esposito (Inter) in, Ange-Yoan Bonny out.
55' Cristian Chivu has decided to make a change. Nicolo Barella (Inter) replaces Piotr Zielinski.
55' Substitution. Luis Henrique makes way for Denzel Dumfries (Inter).
55' Armel Bella-Kotchap (Verona) commits a foul after unfairly battling his opponent for the ball. It's a free kick to Inter, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
54' Inter enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
52' A clumsy foul by Martin Frese (Verona) and Daniele Doveri blows his whistle. It's a free kick to Inter, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
52' Giovane (Verona) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
50' Great teamplay by Verona as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
46' Daniele Doveri has a clear sight and sees a foul from Lautaro Martinez (Inter). Verona are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+4' The end of the first half.
45+3' Gift Orban (Verona) receives a decent pass inside the box and curls in an effort on goal, but the ball hits the outside of the left post and flies out of play.
45+2' The Verona players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
41' Gift Orban (Verona) sees a yellow card. He should be more careful because one more challenge like that could result in a red card.
40' 1 - 1 Goal! Gift Orban plays a long ball to Giovane (Verona), who cuts inside and unleashes a screamer into the left of the goal. The keeper had no chance. Superb strike! 1:1.

38' What a chance that is! Gift Orban (Verona) finds himself unmarked in a promising position after receiving a cross on the edge of the box and his attempt sails a whisker wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Inter will have a goal kick.
36' Giovane (Verona) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
36' Rafik Belghali (Verona) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The ball goes out of play. Verona are awarded a corner kick.
35' Neat link-up play between Lautaro Martinez (Inter) and Ange-Yoan Bonny, but Lorenzo Montipo reads the game well and the move breaks down.
34' Shots on target – 1:5.
31' There's an opportunity for Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
31' Alessandro Bastoni (Inter) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The ball goes out for a corner. Inter can continue in their attacking effort.
29' Martin Frese (Verona) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the resulting corner, but he sends his header straight at the goalkeeper.
29' Corner kick. Giovane (Verona) is ready to send the ball into the box.
29' Giovane (Verona) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender. Verona get a corner.
27' Carlos Augusto (Inter) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
26' Alessandro Bastoni (Inter) is well placed to meet a cross and sends a difficult header towards the left post, but the goalkeeper reacts well to stop the effort.
26' The Inter players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
24' An attempted cross from Rafik Belghali (Verona) is cleared.
20' 28:72 – the latest ball possession ratio.

16' 0 - 1 The ball hits the back of the net! Hakan Calhanoglu delivers the corner, Piotr Zielinski (Inter) finds himself some space on the edge of the box and unleashes an unstoppable shot which goes into the top left corner and past the helpless goalkeeper. 0:1.
16' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
15' Victor Nelsson (Verona) makes a rough challenge and Daniele Doveri blows his whistle for a foul. Inter are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
12' The ball is laid off to Lautaro Martinez (Inter) on the edge of the box. He shoots through a crowd of players low towards the middle of the goal and forces Lorenzo Montipo to make a decent save.
12' Inter are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
9' The resulting corner comes to nothing as Giovane (Verona) sends it out of play.
8' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) steps up to send the ball in.

7' What a great touch by Lautaro Martinez (Inter) as he controls a fine pass into the box and takes a shot to the bottom left corner, but an opposing player makes a clearance. Great defending. The ball goes out of play. Inter are awarded a corner kick.
7' Manuel Akanji (Inter) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
5' Antoine Bernede (Verona) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Daniele Doveri stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
4' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) will take the corner.

3' A sweet pass inside the box gives Piotr Zielinski (Inter) time to measure a shot, but it's slightly mishit and goes just wide of the right post. That really was a great chance! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Verona.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are on the pitch and Inter will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Daniele Doveri.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
